about: The collect of the Second Sunday of Advent. It asks God to stir the heart toward preparing the ways of His Son, and ties that preparing to a mind made clean. The image of the ways comes from the cry of John the Baptist, whom this Sunday's Gospel recalls.

s01.translation: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to prepare the ways of Your Only-begotten Son, so that through His coming we may be found worthy to serve You with purified minds. Who lives with You.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Laity (1846)
translation_citations.locator: parallel Ordinary and Advent propers, examined edition

w005.function: ad with the gerundive states purpose: for the preparing of the ways.

w014.function: An ablative of means: with minds that have been purified — the instrument of the serving, not a clause standing apart.

w018.function: Subjunctive after “ut”: a clause of purpose — that we may deserve.
